Wait.TriggerHint: What triggers it, and what you will do
Wait.CoveringLine: Covering a line rather than an area

Contest.Hint: Roll a contest of attributes against your target
Contest.Title: Contest
Contest.RegularHint: Regular Contest — roll until one side alone succeeds
Contest.Label: {attribute}: {first} vs {second}
Contest.OneTarget: Target exactly one opponent to contest with.
Contest.Unsettled: Still unsettled after {exchanges} exchanges — the GM decides

Evade.Title: Evade
Evade.Label: {mover} evading {foe}
Evade.OneTarget: Target exactly one person to evade.

Affliction.Label: {label} — resist with {resist}
Affliction.NoTarget: Target the people it is being used on first.

Melee.Title: Melee attack
Melee.NoDeception: Skill too low for a Deceptive Attack, which may not take you below 10.

Tactical.MovementHint: Movement points per hex. Turning costs one point per hex-side during a move, and is free at the end of one — to any facing if you spent no more than half your points, otherwise by a single hex-side.
Tactical.Immobile: This posture cannot move hex by hex: sitting cannot move at all, and lying down spends every movement point to shift one hex.

Rules.Title: GURPS rules in play
Rules.MenuHint: Turn individual GURPS rules on or off for this world. A rule that is off behaves as though it had never been written — no penalty, no control, nothing to explain.
Rules.Intro: GURPS is written to be played at several depths. Everything here is optional detail; the spine — success rolls, damage, DR and the active defenses — is always in play.

feint.Name: Feint
feint.Hint: Fake an attack: your margin over the foe's roll comes off his defense against your next attack.

deceptiveAttack.Name: Deceptive Attack
deceptiveAttack.Hint: Trade two points of your own skill for one off the foe's defenses.

rapidStrike.Name: Rapid Strike
rapidStrike.Hint: A second attack in the time of one, both at -6.

retreat.Name: Retreating
retreat.Hint: Step back as you defend: +3 to Dodge, +1 to most parries and blocks.

rapidFire.Name: Rapid fire
rapidFire.Hint: Fire a burst: a bonus for the shots sent, and Recoil decides how many land.

opportunityFire.Name: Opportunity fire
opportunityFire.Hint: Cover ground with a ready weapon on a Wait, and pay for how much of it.

closeCombat.Name: Close combat
closeCombat.Hint: Sharing a hex: only a weapon that reaches close is any use there.

slams.Name: Slams
slams.Hint: Run into someone. Damage comes off how fast you were going.

evading.Name: Evading
evading.Hint: Get past someone without knocking them down, as a Quick Contest of DX.

hitLocations.Name: Hit locations
hitLocations.Hint: Aim at a part of the body, with its own to-hit penalty, DR and wounding.

knockback.Name: Knockback
knockback.Hint: A heavy blow throws the target back, and may knock them down.

criticalTables.Name: Critical hit and miss tables
criticalTables.Hint: A critical does something in particular rather than only being named.

explosions.Name: Explosions
explosions.Hint: Collateral damage falling off with distance, and fragmentation.

afflictions.Name: Afflictions
afflictions.Hint: Attacks resisted with an attribute roll rather than doing damage.

regularContests.Name: Regular Contests
regularContests.Hint: A drawn-out contest of repeated rolls, rather than one apiece.

frightChecks.Name: Fright Checks
frightChecks.Hint: A Will roll against horror, with the Fright Check Table for failures.

extraEffort.Name: Extra Effort
extraEffort.Hint: Spend fatigue to push a roll or a feat of strength beyond its usual limit.

physicalActivities.Name: Physical activities
physicalActivities.Hint: Climbing, jumping, swimming, running, throwing distance and lifting.

knockdown.Name: Knockdown and stunning
knockdown.Hint: A major wound, or a head or vitals hit, calls for a HT roll to stay upright.

bleeding.Name: Bleeding
bleeding.Hint: A wound keeps costing HP each minute until it is bound. The book marks this optional for the bookkeeping.

grappling.Name: Grappling
grappling.Hint: Take hold of a foe, then take them down, pin them, or choke them.

CombatStyle.Name: Combat system
CombatStyle.Hint: Basic combat is abstract: everyone can reach everyone and nobody has a back. Tactical combat is fought on a hex map, where facing decides what you can defend against. Tactical needs a hex-gridded scene; on any other grid the table falls back to basic.

Hint.points: How many points the character is built on, and how many may come back from disadvantages. Both are the GM's call for the campaign.
Hint.attributes: ST, DX, IQ and HT start at 10. Everything else on the sheet is worked out from them.
Hint.advantages: What the character is unusually good at. The cost comes off the budget above.
Hint.disadvantages: What the character is stuck with. These pay points back, up to the limit above.
Hint.skills: What the character has learned. Points spent on each are set on the sheet afterwards.
Hint.gear: What the character carries. Weight counts against encumbrance once it is marked carried.
Hint.review: What the character has come to. Nothing here is fixed — the sheet edits all of it.

Browse.gear: Add gear, armour or a shield

Picker.Title: Add from the compendia
Picker.Gear: Add gear, armour or a shield
Picker.NotFound: That compendium entry could not be loaded.

Skill.SpendMore: Spend the next step of points
Skill.SpendLess: Take back the last step of points
Skill.NoDefaultsYet: No defaults. Without one this skill cannot be rolled untrained.

Trait.CostTableHint: A few traits are priced from a table rather than at a flat rate per level: Wealth runs 10/20/30/50/75. Fill this in and it replaces the points and per-level figures. Leave it empty for the great majority, which are priced evenly.
Trait.AppliedHint: This system applies this trait itself — its bonus is already in the numbers on the sheet.

Item.Name: Item name
Item.NoModesYet: No attacks yet. Add one to make this a weapon.

Hint.DisadvantageLimit: A rule of thumb, not a hard cap. Disadvantages and quirks both count.
Hint.Languages: Accented is -1 to skills that depend on language. One native language is free.
Hint.NoMeleeAttacks: No melee attacks. Add equipment with an attack mode on the Gear tab.
Hint.Overloaded: Carrying more than ten times Basic Lift. This character cannot move under this load.
Hint.Techniques: bought up from a prerequisite skill
Hint.HitLocations: Unaimed blows hit the torso. Eye and Vitals can only be targeted deliberately, and only by impaling, piercing or tight-beam burning attacks.

Roll.TooLowToAttempt: {label}: effective {effective} is below 3, so the roll cannot be attempted.

Chat.Blast: Explosion — collateral damage out to {yards} yards
Chat.NoTarget: Target or select a token first.
Chat.CannotApply: You do not have permission to change: {names}
Chat.MajorWound: Major wound — HT roll to avoid knockdown and stunning
Chat.ConsciousnessRoll: HT roll to stay conscious, at
Chat.SubtractDR: Subtract the target's DR from basic damage, then apply the wounding modifier.
Chat.SubtractDRDivisor: Divide the target's DR by {divisor} (rounding down), subtract it from basic damage, then apply the wounding modifier.

Technique.MaxRelativeHint: Relative to the prerequisite skill. Zero lets the technique reach that skill but not exceed it.

Armor.LocationsHint: Locations covered. Leave all unticked for whole-body coverage.
Armor.SplitHint: Armour written “4/2” stops one kind of attack better than another. Leave the second DR blank unless it does.

Critical.halfDrDown: DR protects at half value, rounding down
Critical.halfDrUp: DR protects at half value, rounding up
Critical.halfDrUpMajor: DR at half value rounding up; anything through is a major wound
Critical.majorWound: Anything through DR is a major wound
Critical.doubleShock: Double shock, to a maximum of -8; a limb struck is crippled too
Critical.dropsHeld: Normal damage, and the victim drops whatever he is holding
Critical.treatAsEye: Treat as a hit to the eye; if impossible, treat as a 4
Critical.offBalance: Knocked off balance: Do Nothing next turn, but may defend
Critical.deafenedOrScarred: If damage penetrates: deafened by crushing, badly scarred otherwise
Critical.dropsWeapon: Normal damage, and the victim drops his weapon
Critical.weaponBreaks: Your weapon breaks; a resistant weapon rolls again
Critical.hitYourself: You hit yourself in the arm or leg
Critical.hitYourselfHalf: You hit yourself in the arm or leg, for half damage
Critical.loseBalance: You lose your balance: nothing until your next turn, defenses at -2
Critical.weaponTurns: The weapon turns in your hand: Ready it before using it again
Critical.weaponFlies: Swinging, the weapon flies 1d yards from your hand; otherwise you drop it
Critical.strainShoulder: You strain your shoulder: your weapon arm is unusable for 30 minutes
Critical.knockYourselfOut: You knock yourself out; roll vs HT every 30 minutes to recover
Critical.strainLimb: You strain the limb: 1 HP and unusable for 30 minutes
Critical.hitSolidObject: You hit a solid object: thrust crushing damage to the part you used
Critical.hitSolidObjectHalf: You hit a solid object, for half thrust crushing damage
Critical.stumble: You stumble past your foe and end your turn facing away from him
Critical.trip: You trip: roll against DX to avoid falling down
Critical.dropGuard: You drop your guard: defenses at -2, and Evaluate and Feint count double
Critical.tearMuscle: You tear a muscle: 1d-3 injury to the limb, off balance next turn

Knockback.StayUp: DX, Acrobatics or Judo to stay standing

Feint.Hint: Fake this attack so the next one is harder to defend against
Feint.Label: {weapon} feint vs {foe}
Feint.OneTarget: Target exactly one foe to feint.
Feint.Landed: {foe} defends at {penalty} against your next attack

Fright.Hint: A Will roll to resist fear, capped at 13 by the Rule of 14
Fright.Title: Fright Check

Effect.stunnedRecovers: Stunned for one second, then recovers
Effect.stunnedWillUnmodified: Stunned; roll against unmodified Will each second to snap out of it
Effect.stunnedWillModified: Stunned; roll against modified Will each second to snap out of it
Effect.stunned1d: Stunned for 1d seconds, then modified Will each second
Effect.stunned2d: Stunned for 2d seconds, then modified Will each second
Effect.retching: Retching for (25 - HT) seconds, then HT each second to recover
Effect.loseFpAndStun: Loses 1d FP and is stunned for 1d seconds
Effect.stunAndQuirk: Stunned for 1d seconds and gains a new quirk
Effect.faint: Faints for 1d minutes, then HT each minute to recover
Effect.faintAndFall: Faints as above; HT at once or take 1 HP collapsing
Effect.severeFaint: Severe faint for 2d minutes, and 1 HP of injury
Effect.faintNearShock: Faint bordering on shock for 4d minutes, and 1d FP
Effect.panic: Panics for 1d minutes, then unmodified Will each minute
Effect.phobia10: Gains a -10-point Phobia or other mental disadvantage
Effect.physical15: A major physical effect worth -15 points
Effect.worseSelfControl: A related self-control number worsens a step, or a new -10-point disadvantage
Effect.faintAndDelusion10: Faints for 1d minutes and gains a -10-point Delusion
Effect.faintAndPhobia10: Faints for 1d minutes and gains a -10-point mental disadvantage
Effect.lightComa: Light coma; HT every 30 minutes, then -2 to everything for 6 hours
Effect.coma: Coma for 1d hours, then HT to wake, and again if it fails
Effect.catatonia: Catatonia for 1d days, then HT to wake, and again if it fails
Effect.seizure: Seizure for 1d minutes, costing 1d FP; HT or take 1d injury
Effect.totalPanic: Total panic, out of control; Will to come out of it
Effect.phobia15: Gains a -15-point Phobia or other mental disadvantage
Effect.physical20: A severe physical effect worth -20 points
Effect.physical30: A severe physical effect worth -30 points
Effect.comaAndPhobiaAndIq: Coma, a -15-point mental disadvantage, and 1 IQ lost permanently

Fright.Unfazeable: {name} is Unfazeable and makes no Fright Check.

ExtraEffort.Title: Extra Effort
ExtraEffort.Hint: Push past your limits: a Will roll at -1 per 5% asked, and a point of fatigue
ExtraEffort.MotivatedHint: Driven by fear, anger or concern for a loved one (+5)
ExtraEffort.Success: Gains the {percent}% — the task itself still has to be rolled
ExtraEffort.Failure: Achieves only what they would have without the effort
ExtraEffort.CriticalSuccess: Gains the increase, and it costs no fatigue at all
ExtraEffort.CriticalFailure: The task fails outright, and costs {hp} HP
ExtraEffort.NaturalEighteen: Roll against HT or take a temporary disadvantage — the GM says which
ExtraEffort.NotStBased: Mighty Blows adds nothing to damage that is not ST-based.

Feats.Hint: Jumping, lifting, running, swimming and throwing, from ST, Basic Lift and Move.
Feats.TooHeavy: Too heavy to throw — past a two-handed lift

Fall.Title: Fall
Fall.Hint: A fall is a collision with the ground: how far, onto what, and how well
Fall.BluntTrauma: Armour stopped it, but {hp} HP of blunt trauma got through
Fall.ExcessKept: {hp} past crippling, taken off HP rather than discarded

Recovery.RestHint: Quiet rest: 1 FP per 10 minutes, and one more for a meal
Recovery.DailyHint: A day of rest and decent food: HT for 1 HP
Recovery.DailyDetail: A day of rest and decent food
Recovery.OneTarget: Target exactly one patient to treat.
Recovery.WakingHint: Try to come round after being knocked out
Recovery.Waking_automatic: Above 0 HP: awake again in 15 minutes, no roll needed
Recovery.Waking_hourly: At 0 HP or below: HT every hour to wake
Recovery.Waking_mortal: At -1×HP or below: one HT roll after 12 hours
Recovery.Mortal: Will not wake without medical help — HT every 12 hours or die
Recovery.AlreadyWell: Already as well as they are going to get
Recovery.MealHint: Ate a decent meal while resting (+1 FP)
Recovery.RestedFed: {minutes} minutes of quiet rest, with a meal

Knockdown.Title: Knockdown and stunning
Knockdown.knockedDown: Stunned, and down — Do Nothing next turn, defenses at -4
Knockdown.recovered: Shakes it off and can act normally
Knockdown.stillStunned: Still stunned — Do Nothing, and roll again next turn
Knockdown.ShakeHint: HT to recover from stun at the end of your turn; shift-click for mental stun

Bleeding.Hint: A minute of bleeding: HT at -1 per 5 HP already lost
Bleeding.Title: Bleeding
Bleeding.Held: No blood lost this minute — {minutes} of 3 quiet minutes

Grapple.Hint: Take hold of a foe: they cannot walk away, and most of what they could do is gone
Grapple.Title: Grapple
Grapple.Label: {skill} to grapple {foe}
Grapple.OneTarget: Target exactly one foe to grapple.
Grapple.NotGrappled: Nobody is holding on to you.
Grapple.MustBeHolding: Only the one doing the holding can try that.
Grapple.PinRequires: A pin needs a foe on the ground, held by the torso.
Grapple.BreakFreeHint: A Quick Contest of ST against the grip holding you
Grapple.Free: Free — and may move one yard in any direction.
Grapple.FreeAutomatically: {foe} is unconscious and holding on to nothing.
Grapple.TakedownHint: Bear a standing foe to the ground — and go down yourself if you lose
Grapple.PinHint: A Regular Contest of ST to pin a foe already on the ground
Grapple.ChokeHint: ST against the higher of their ST or HT; damage is the margin
Grapple.StateHolding: Holding on with {hands} — Aim, Feint, Concentrate, Wait and ranged attacks are out
Grapple.StateHeld: Held with {hands} — no Move, no Aim, no ranged attacks, and nothing longer than a dagger
Grapple.StatePinned: Pinned and helpless — no maneuver that needs physical movement

Sight.Label: What you can see
Sight.positionKnown: Nothing, but you know where they are (-4)

Cover.Label: Cover
Cover.randomLocation: Roll the location, and risk the cover
Cover.shootThrough: Shoot through it (-2, and its DR)

Dying.mortallyWounded: Mortally wounded — incapacitated, and dying by halves
Dying.MortalWoundHint: The roll a mortally wounded character makes every half-hour
Dying.lingers: Lingers — roll again at the end of the next interval
Dying.recovered: Pulls through — no longer mortally wounded, but still incapacitated
Dying.CripplingHint: How serious a crippling turned out to be, rolled at the end of combat
Dying.temporary: Temporary — it goes when they are back at full HP
Dying.permanent: Permanent — the body part is gone or useless

Air.Hint: Time without air: a point of fatigue a second, and four minutes is fatal
Air.Title: Suffocation
Air.None: No air at all — choked, buried, holding a breath run out
Air.Water: Drowning — some air, and a lot of water
Air.WillRolls: Out of fatigue — Will every second or fall unconscious
Air.BrainDamage: Past two minutes — HT on recovery or lose a point of IQ
Air.BreatheHint: Stops the clock and starts recovering fatigue

Disarm.Hint: Strike at a foe's weapon to knock it out of their hand
Disarm.Title: Disarm
Disarm.Fencing: Fencing weapon — main-gauche, rapier, saber, smallsword (no -2)
Disarm.TwoHandedOption: They have both hands on it (+2 to them)
Disarm.Label: Strike at {foe}'s weapon
Disarm.OneTarget: Target exactly one foe to disarm.
Disarm.NoWeapon: No weapon skill to strike with.
Disarm.Disarmed: {foe} is disarmed — the weapon flies a yard.
Disarm.Unready: {foe} keeps the weapon, but it is unready.

Subdue.Turned: Strike with the flat or the butt (crushing)

Ground.Label: Ground
Ground.Higher3: Three feet above them (they defend at -1)
Ground.Higher5: Five feet or more above them (-3)
